나무를 베기 전엔 말하지.\n미안하다, 고맙다.\n이 숲 나무는 대답을:
I speak before I fell a tree.
Sorry, and thank you.
The trees here never answer.
Back again, ha ha!
That stump from last time
sprouted a shoot. I'm forgiven.
뿌리와 재를 다루는 오크 견습 주술사: Orc apprentice shaman who works with roots and ash
…이 집의 재는 깨끗하군요.\n스승이 말했어요.\n재가 깨끗한 집은 믿으:
...The ash in this house is clean.
My master said,
trust a house with clean ash.
숲의 뿌리가 검게 물들어요.\n제가 아는 약으론 모자라요.\n…당신은 아:
The forest roots are turning black.
The remedies I know aren't enough.
...But you would know.
I'm back.
I took the ash last time
and used it in a rite. It went well.
뼈를 던져 내일을 읽는 오크 노파: Old orc woman who reads tomorrow in thrown bones
The bones pointed to this house.
So here I am.
Ask the bones why.
I cast them.
Tonight the door will rattle three times.
...Don't open it the fourth.
또 왔다, 애야.\n뼈가 같은 집을 두 번 가리키면\n그건 집이 아니라:
Back again, child.
When the bones point to the same house twice,
it isn't the house. It's the person.
조상의 발자국을 따라 걷는 오크: Orc who walks in his ancestors' footsteps
조상들이 이 길을 걸었소.\n그때도 여기 불이 있었다지.\n…같은 불이오:
My ancestors walked this road.
They say a fire burned here even then.
...Is it the same fire?
I bowed before the stone in the forest.
It wasn't my ancestors.
It was something far older.
I have returned.
The pilgrimage never ends.
This house has simply joined the road.
솥째 나눠 먹자는 오크 요리사: Orc cook who says to share the whole pot
부엌! 부엌부터 봅시다!\n…좋아요. 오늘 저녁은\n제가 합니다. 다 같:
The kitchen! Let's see the kitchen first!
...Good. I'll make
dinner tonight. For everyone!
숲의 것들도 배가 고픈 거예요.\n…아니, 먹이진 말고요.\n우리부터 먹:
The things in the forest get hungry too.
...No, don't feed them.
Let's eat first.
또 왔어요! 국자 들고요!\n지난번 솥, 아직 있죠?\n이번엔 두 배로:
I'm back! Ladle in hand!
You still have that pot, right?
We'll make double this time.
